build_STFT_module: build a PyTorch STFT module with configurable filter length, hop length, window length, and window type for audio processing
run_STFT_transform: run the STFT transform method on audio input data to extract magnitude and phase spectrograms
run_STFT_inverse: run the STFT inverse method on magnitude and phase tensors to reconstruct the original audio waveform
run_STFT_forward: run the STFT forward pass to perform a full transform and inverse reconstruction of audio input data
review_STFT_class: review the STFT class implementation for differentiable short-time Fourier transform using conv1d and conv_transpose1d
